summary.excluded_accounts: Admins, support staff, reporting viewers and test accounts are not counted.

active_learners.definition: Distinct learners who, during the window, opened a lesson, played a lesson video, saved lesson progress, completed or un-completed a lesson, started a download, posted a question or submitted a review.
active_learners.caveat: Partial: lesson opens and playback were not recorded before tracking started, and progress keeps only each learner's latest save per lesson, so earlier activity can be missing. Treat as a lower bound.

minutes_learned.definition: Wall-clock minutes a lesson video was playing in a visible browser tab in the CareerOS lesson player, credited at most once per real second per learner. Not playhead position and not lesson length.
minutes_learned.reason: Visible playback tracking has not recorded any learner yet (it starts once the update is published and a learner watches).
minutes_learned.tracking_needed: Visible playback tracking records wall-clock seconds while a lesson video plays in a visible tab. It goes live when the app is published and a learner watches; choose a window starting on or after tracked_since.

new_questions.definition: Lesson questions created during the window.

new_reviews.definition: Reviews first submitted during the window; later edits are not counted as new.
